_about: Package ZC stock atlas, zone C (x 690-1250). Continuous panel px [x0, y0, x1, y1]. Edges at 50 % between local black and the element plateau on 4x rectified crops (package R rects). Colours are photo colours (sRGB decoded), white text = 1.0. No text content anywhere.
independence_note: 62 = 08, 61 = 09, 60 = 10, 68 = 39 are the same frames (package H); independent message captures are 62 and 66 only; 64 and 67 show the same road string.

faint_tail_extent.note: where the tapered tip falls to 0.5 % of white (photo 62 rows)

arc.same_for_one_and_two_lines: yes: 62 (two lines) and 66 (one line) agree within 0.9 px (registration)

fill.what: a gradient under the arc, separated from the arc by a ~2 px dark line, brightest just under the flat part, fading downward and towards both tips; no hard edge except the arc on top
fill.colour_note: warm purple-grey in the photos (linear R > B > G, about 1 : 0.6 : 0.85 just under the arc); not display-calibrated
fill.evidence: 62 (cleanest black), 66, and 17 (theme connected) agree in shape; above the arc the same distance from the text reads black, so it is not camera bloom

relation.evidence: session photo 58: with our opaque paint above and below, BMW's message and symbol show only in the 13 px gap y 652-666; no arc shows above it

theme_connected_17_vs_66.symbol_and_text_x: 17 reads 2-3.5 px further left than 66 for symbol and text, not for the arc: at 17's 0.64 photo px per panel px this is inside its registration; no change shown

bottom.cc_info.note: neither left, centre nor right anchored exactly (right edges 752.75 / 756.0); the slot holds a symbol up to ~45 px wide ending at x 753-756

anchor.evidence: three lines of different width (299, 277, 261 px) on two independent captures

widest_box.from: spec 5.3 one-line band, consistent with centre 968.6; not settled by any photo (BMW wraps long messages)

anchor.evidence: three different strings (330, 282, 98 px wide); 64 and 67 are the same string

bottom.odometer.anchor: hypothesis: the digit group is centred on x ~960.5 (one string only); label hangs left, unit right

ghost_63.what: BMW's standby odometer at about 2-3 % of white, digits in the same place as 65 within 2.5 px: a frame of the standby-to-normal cross-fade (hypothesis on the cause)

rail.centre.what: the two hooks between the dials' bottom lines, present in every no-message state (61, 63, 64, 65, 67, 68, and 60 with the theme connected) and absent while a message shows
rail.centre.message_state_summary: with a message the speedo rail ends at x 685-687 with a rounded end (no slant) and the tacho rail starts at 1232.2-1232.6: both about 7 px further from the centre than the no-message notches
rail.centre.relation: under (58: no BMW hook or rail in our opaque paint)

unattributed_ids.map.region (foot): faint light at y 601-610 under the map in 61 / 68 (map lines reaching the strip)
unattributed_ids.glass specks: point-like at (792, 622), (748, 687), (869, 603), (771, 692), (932, 641), (1113, 624), (740, 604), (824, 649) in 64 / 65 / 67, the same places in each: dust on the cover glass, not display content (hypothesis; absent in 61 / 63 / 68)

unexplained.note: both are the reflection-angle photos; probably a reflection
